facts.fact: The Direction generale des douanes and SOGESY launched Sylvie 2 on 17 February 2025, the electronic single window for import and export clearance, running since 2016 and collecting documents from technical administrations and private bodies.
Sylvie 2 improves interfacing with SYDONIA, the automated customs system, and facilitates customs clearance operations, per the customs director general.
